entities.name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
entities.description: Human/merfolk hybrid biomancer of the Simic Combine on Ravnica, former Gruul clan leader.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Ravnican guild; Vorel once led a small clan.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: Guild whose growing garrison Vorel conceded territory to.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Maze that Vorel ran for the Simic.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: Location where chaos ensued after the maze run.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Dimir guildmaster who instigated the chaos.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who linked the maze-runners' minds and became Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Event that made Jace Ravnica's Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Simic Prime Speaker Vorel thought should be replaced.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Simic leader whose leadership Vorel advocated.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who spoke with Vorel at the guild meeting.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle against Bolas and the Dreadhorde on Ravnica.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Spell cast by Bolas before the guild meeting.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of the undead that the Simic fought.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Resurrected as the new Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Vorel concedes territory to the Boros and his Gruul clan turns on him; he nearly dies and escapes.
events.quote: the clan turned on him. He was nearly killed before escaping.

events.summary: Vorel joins the Simic and is experimented on, gaining merfolk traits.
events.quote: Experimented on, he received some merfolk traits.

events.summary: Vorel completes the Implicit Maze run and arrives at the Forum of Azor, where Lazav instigates chaos.
events.quote: He completed the run successfully and showed up at the Forum of Azor

events.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Living Guildpact.
events.quote: which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact

events.summary: Vorel represents Vannifar at the guild meeting and tells Ral Zarek she had prepared for war.
events.quote: Vorel told Ral Zarek that Vannifar was a fighter

events.summary: Vorel leads the Simic into battle against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: he led the Simic terraformers, super-soldiers and merfolk into the battle against the Dreadhorde

relations.quote: biomancer from the Simic Combine on
he was the first and loudest advocate for Vannifar 's leadership

relations.note: formerly led a small Gruul clan
relations.quote: Vorel used to be the human leader of a small Gruul clan.
